{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(data))

# Check how many duplicates there are
duplicate_count = len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", duplicate_count)

# Check for the -999 sentinel in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print("Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:", sentinel_count)

# Check if there are any rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("First 5 rows with -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].head())"}
